item.title: Bulletin updated at 19:50 HKT 16/Jul/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Talim will continue to intensify today and tomorrow, and move in the general direction of Leizhou Peninsula and Hainan Island. It will bring squally showers and thunderstorms to the coast of Guangdong. Talim is expected to depart from the coast of Guangdong midweek this week. However, under the influence of a broad trough of low pressure over the central and northern parts of the South China Sea, there will still be showers over the coast of Guangdong. An anticyclone aloft will strengthen towards the weekend, the weather will improve slightly over Guangdong.

Date/Month: 17/07 (Monday)
Wind: East to northeast force 7, occasionally force 8. Becoming east to southeast force 7 to 8, up to force 9 offshore and on high ground. East to southeast force 6 to 7 later.
Weather: Cloudy to overcast with squally showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavy at times. Seas will be rough to very rough with swells.
Temp range: 26 - 29 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
